Hi Tim — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details & attachments below.

1) Storage: By default, ephemeral request and response artifacts for the hosted API are retained for 30 days for debugging, monitoring, and quality checks. After 30 days they are removed from the primary datastore; indexing/analytics extracts are removed within 90 days.

2) EU-only option: Yes. For accounts that require EU residency we route and store data in our eu-west region (EU cluster) by account flag. That is configurable at onboarding and can be enforced via our Console or API.

3) Deletion SLA: We accept deletion requests via support ticket + signed request. Application-layer data is deleted from the live store within 48 hours of validated request. We then kick off cascading deletion across caches and services; finalization across all systems (including index and analytics) completes within 30 days.

4) Backups/snapshots: Provider-managed snapshots (incremental EBS-style snapshots) are short-lived; we mark objects for purge immediately but physical deletion from provider snapshots can take up to 30 days depending on provider reclaim windows. For EU-resident accounts we request provider-side retention to be limited to EU zones.

5) Audit logs & attestation: Operational audit logs (control-plane actions, admin access) are kept for 90 days by default; we can provide a deletion attestation signed by Redwood Legal after completion of the purge.

Attachments: hosted-data-policies.pdf (policy summary), eu-data-location-matrix.csv (region routing matrix), deletion-playbook.md (short playbook for deletion process).

Tim/Jasmine — quick technical confirmation: 

- Live application data deletion: confirmed — application-store objects are removed within 48 hours after validated request.
- Snapshots/backups: provider snapshots are incremental; when we delete objects we immediately mark snapshots for reclamation. Provider reclaim/garbage-collection windows vary by vendor; empirically we see physical reclaim complete within 7–30 days. For eu-west there is no cross-region replication by default for our account type, but we can request provider-side residency controls at onboarding to harden this.
- Cold backups (archival exports) are retained per policy; if a customer requests full purge we will run a targeted purge job and coordinate with the provider to expedite reclaim. We log the purge job and provide a report.

Operational steps we will take for Northbridge:
1) Validate deletion request + legal signature.
2) Delete from live store (48 hours).
3) Invalidate caches/KV & remove indexes (up to 30 days for full index reingestion).
4) Submit snapshot purge requests to provider and track progress (expect up to 30 days worst-case).
5) Produce a purge report + attestation and deliver to customer.

I can be the technical contact to confirm completion if you like.
